# Imam Bahri Alwi

> Imam Bahri Alwi is a full-stack developer in Jakarta, Indonesia, building production web and mobile systems across frontend, backend, databases, authentication, payments, automation, and SEO. Primary stack: TypeScript, Next.js, React Native, Node.js, NestJS, Express, Prisma, PostgreSQL, and Supabase.

The site is a personal portfolio. Indonesian is the default language and is served
at the bare path; English lives under /en. Both languages carry the same content.

## Current role

Software Engineer (Contract) at PT Brifion Marden Group (October 2026 - present).
Work covers a supermarket/distribution system, backend and database design,
authentication and access control, stock and journal foundations, transaction
integrity, integration testing, solution demos, and AI-assisted outreach planning.
Previously Full-Stack Developer at Konten.com (June - October 2026). Also built
the Kelas Clipper backend: 76 endpoints on a shared production database serving
approximately 150,000 accounts.

## Projects

- [Knect](https://www.imambahri.com/project/knect): HRIS with a NestJS API, Next.js administration, and Flutter employee app; organization and employee records, shifts, GPS/face attendance, requests/approvals, payroll/payslips, performance, recruitment, announcements, notifications, and reports
- [Taskflow](https://www.imambahri.com/project/taskflow): projects, Kanban, scheduling, workload, collaboration, attachments, notifications, reports, project documents, custom statuses/fields, and OAuth-based MCP connections for AI assistants; an account is required
- [Satria Gear](https://www.imambahri.com/project/satria-gear): esports tournament platform with an admin operations dashboard, Midtrans payment automation, and an AI agent wired into Discord, GitHub Actions, and Vercel deploy logs
- [OpenClaw Discord AI Moderator](https://www.imambahri.com/project/openclaw): prototype testing whether AI agents can carry real community moderation workflows
- [TypeSynq Royale](https://www.imambahri.com/project/typesynq-royale): real-time multiplayer typing battle with on-chain betting on the Monad Testnet; top 6 at the official Monad Game Hackathon
- [Galaxy POS](https://www.imambahri.com/project/galaxy-pos): Laravel multi-branch POS with retail, repairs, stock/returns, cash/bank/capital, loans/assets, double-entry journals, ledgers, financial statements, VAT summaries, period closing, and an offline Electron/PHP/SQLite Windows desktop app with backup/restore
- [Maneka](https://www.imambahri.com/project/maneka): AI-powered career planning app built on Howard Gardner's Theory of Multiple Intelligences
